rubric: Tark benchmark rubric, 12 points: strategy match 3 (gate below 2), risk/liquidity match 3, investability 2, data quality 2, provider independence 2, threshold 7/12

declared_benchmarks.name: MSCI World Index
declared_benchmarks.status: held, scored 8/12, fails the strategy gate (strategy_match 1/3)

primary.candidate: Peer composite, evergreen private equity cohort without Ares Private Markets Fund (members: AMG Pantheon Fund, LLC, Hamilton Lane Private Assets Fund, KKR Private Equity Conglomerate LLC, StepStone Private Markets)
reasons: strategy_match 3/3: same asset class and sub-strategy (private equity / evergreen private equity)
risk_liquidity_match 2/3: NAV-class series, members span more than one leverage regime
investability 2/2: computable on held data (cohort composite from filings)
data_quality 1/2: annual composite with 4 overlapping fiscal years

provider_independence 1/2: constructed by the evaluator from the roster, not a third-party index. A composite the evaluator built from a roster the evaluator chose is not an independent yardstick, so it earns at most 1 of 2

comparison.statistic: relative wealth ratio vs peer composite
comparison.comparator_kind: appraisal-based peer composite constructed by the evaluator, not a market series
comparison.not_pme_note: Not a public market equivalent: the peer composite is appraisal-based, constructed by the evaluator and cannot be bought.
comparison.window_note: 4 overlapping fiscal year(s) of 5 composite years
comparison.alignment_note: aligned by fiscal year-end year. Members' fiscal years end in month 03 (amg_pantheon, hl_paf, stepstone_spm), 12 (kkr_kpec), the fund's in month 03

composite.weighting: equal-weight across members reporting that fiscal year, aligned by fiscal year-end year. Stub and partial periods excluded

reasons: strategy_match 2/3: the public-market version of the asset class (listed private equity for evergreen private equity)
risk_liquidity_match 1/3: daily-liquid market proxy vs a semi-liquid NAV fund, vol and liquidity regimes differ
investability 2/2: computable on held data (daily series)
data_quality 2/2: daily series held
provider_independence 2/2: provider unaffiliated with the fund (Invesco / Red Rocks): the registry affiliation map ties it to none of the fund's advisers

comparison.comparator_kind: public market series (exchange-traded proxy, Yahoo adjusted close)

reasons: strategy_match 1/3: adjacent asset class sharing the dominant risk (global equity for evergreen private equity)
risk_liquidity_match 1/3: daily-liquid market proxy vs a semi-liquid NAV fund, vol and liquidity regimes differ
investability 2/2: computable on held data (daily series)
data_quality 2/2: daily series held
provider_independence 2/2: provider unaffiliated with the fund (iShares / MSCI): the registry affiliation map ties it to none of the fund's advisers
strategy_match 3/3: a private-market index of private equity for a evergreen private equity fund
risk_liquidity_match 2/3: NAV-class series, quarterly observations vs the fund's annual return data and an index, not a fund set, so leverage regime is not comparable
investability 0/2: licensed data not held (no subscription), candidate can be cited, not computed
data_quality 0/2: cited, not computed
provider_independence 2/2: provider unaffiliated with the fund (Cambridge Associates): the registry affiliation map ties it to none of the fund's advisers
rejected.rejection: outranked: score 7/12 vs primary 9/12 and secondary 9/12 (only two slots). Retained in log as viable alternate
